title: Tsuruga Kehi routs Yokote 10-0 and advances at the Summer Koshien
summary: Four pitchers combined for a shutout and the offense woke up in the first-round game, which marked Yokote's return after 57 years.

title: Aeon admits allowing re-entry into Kumamoto shopping center before explosion
summary: The company acknowledged that employees went back inside to retrieve valuables after the earthquake; the blast left seven dead.

title: Japan successfully launches H3 rocket No. 9 with an operational satellite
summary: The launch from Tanegashima was celebrated by JAXA and the government, which plan to consolidate the space program with several launches a year.

title: Typhoon 15 approaches Kanto from the east and causes flight cancellations
summary: The unusual trajectory could bring the storm ashore on the night of the 11th, with more than 60 flights canceled and train services suspended.

title: Chiben Wakayama beats Shakuto and advances at Koshien after five years
summary: The Wakayama school got past the first round for the first time in five years in a Kansai showdown.

title: Kumamoto continues its recovery two weeks after the earthquake
summary: Thousands of people remain evacuated while support work, infrastructure reconstruction and psychological care for those affected move forward.

title: Tension escalates between U.S. and Iran with military moves and oil prices rising
summary: Tehran appoints a military chief, Trump rejects Iranian demands and crude rises amid stalled negotiations; Japan mediates with Oman.

title: A 35-year-old woman drowns in a river in Kochi while swimming with her family
summary: The incident occurred in Kochi Prefecture; an 18-year-old man remains missing in a coastal area.

title: Tokyo Metro halts Hanzomon Line due to asbestos at station
summary: Service between Shibuya and Kudanshita was suspended after asbestos-containing material was found at Hanzomon Station.

title: Yokohama eliminates defending champion Okinawa Shogaku at Koshien
summary: Yokohama's pitcher dominated with 12 strikeouts, while Okinawa Shogaku's starter struggled with control in his final appearance.

title: Kogawa Gakuen beats Takaoka Sho at the Summer Koshien
summary: Kogawa scored seven runs and took advantage of Takaoka Sho's six defensive errors, which only scored in the final inning.

title: Riseisha and Kyoei face off in the first round of the Summer Koshien
summary: Batter Tsuji, son of a former Orix player, is one of Riseisha's attractions in their debut against Kyoei.
